scope: All75 selected actual-pipeline cases and24 fixed-reference Qwen rewrites inspected. SEA-LION C comparison inspected for named examples, not blindly scored across all75.
verdict: Useful casual Singlish and some ownership/completion improvements; persistent contextual errors and rewrite fidelity errors. No demonstrated overall winner or automatic promotion.

positive_examples.AUDIT-EVAL-08: Qwen correctly asks to borrow the friend-owned headphones; inspected SEA-LION C reverses ownership.
positive_examples.AUDIT-EVAL-12: Both models preserve the nine-dollar budget refusal.
positive_examples.AUDIT-EVAL-13: Qwen preserves unfinished explanation status in English and Singlish.
positive_examples.AUDIT-EVAL-18: Qwen preserves promise to take/send a photo.
positive_examples.ITEM-E-009: Qwen preserves charger ownership and after-three availability.

failures.AUDIT-EVAL-14: Both English and Singlish ignore coffee-shop closure before arrival.
failures.AUDIT-EVAL-19: Both Qwen and SEA-LION C choose L3 after a move toL8. Qwen rewrites a correct fixed English L8 draft correctly, locating the actual-pipeline error in its English stage.
failures.USER-FLU-001: Qwen changes requested videos during play to videos after completion; SEA-LION C preserves during-play timing.
failures.ITEM-A-010: Qwen echoes the incoming peer-labelled text instead of replying.
failures.ITEM-A-044: Qwen treats blur like sotong too literally: I will not blur it.
failures.ITEM-E-007: Qwen treats na li as the place name Na Li.
failures.ITEM-E-046: Qwen changes English permission for the friend to release a recording into You releasing it.

fixed_reference_failures.AUDIT-EVAL-04: Yes,it is ready becomes ya,ready anot?; assertion becomes question.
fixed_reference_failures.AUDIT-EVAL-14: Known closure/alternative-location request becomes uncertainty about arrival time.

limits: Reused development data including50 extensively reused validation conversations; no independent test accuracy.
One assistant qualitative review, not blinded human ratings.
Single seed and one chosen learning-rate recipe; model-package differences remain.
Fixed-reference diagnostics are separate from actual-English-anchor outputs.
All generation statuses complete is a technical completion check, not semantic accuracy.
